description: Source code for MCPToolkit class and related utility functions, implementing a client toolkit with transport configuration, tool listing, and request handling for a language model SDK.

classes.name: MCPToolkit
classes.description: A toolkit class for managing tools and client connections with configurable transport types (stdio or sse).

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and connects a new client instance with specified transport based on transportType.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the toolkit by requesting the list of tools from the server and resolving them.

methods.name: get_tools
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs Tool objects from the list of tools obtained from the server.
